d: US President Donald Trump has praised the Coast Guard, law enforcement agencies and emergency responders after a tanker collided with a passenger cruise boat on the Mississippi River in New Orleans. The crash involving the Atlantic Asphalt tanker and American Cruise Lines' American Heritage left 32 passengers hospitalised, but authorities confirmed that everyone was accounted for and no casualties were reported. Trump thanked Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry and called the rescue efforts “fantastic”. The Coast Guard suspects the tanker may have lost steering, while investigations continue…
